title: A chiral superlattice route to spin-split topological antiferromagnetism
title_zh: 手性超晶格通往自旋分裂拓扑反铁磁性的路径
abstract: Chirality has emerged as a new mechanism for inducing spin and Berry-curvature phenomena in quantum materials and molecular chemistry1-7. Collinear antiferromagnets (AFMs) are promising for spintronics and topological magnetism, yet realizing large Berry curvature and spin-split bands remains challenging8,9. Here we report a chiral-superlattice route to spin-split topological phenomena from collinear antiferromagnetism. We study the collinear AFM UOTe, in which we show a spontaneous chiral superlattice arising from frozen chiral phonons at a finite wave vector. Without the superlattice, the pristine collinear AFM in UOTe has neither Berry curvature nor spin-split bands. When electrons move through the chiral superlattice, their orbital Bloch wavefunction and quantum geometry are modulated by the strong chiral superlattice potential, generating large Berry curvature, which we detect by the nonlinear Hall effect. At 150 K, the chiral-superlattice-induced Berry curvature couples to the collinear AFM order, leading to an anomalous Hall angle of about 0.14 abruptly near the Néel temperature TN which is among the largest in bulk magnets. Moreover, our spin Hanle precession measurement shows that the chiral superlattice also generates spin-polarized current from the collinear AFM, a long-standing goal in spintronics. We shed light on the supermodulation formation mechanism based on chemical ion size and physical interlayer-intralayer energy competitions, which we use to propose a design principle to discover similar bond-mismatch superlattices, providing a chiral superlattice pathway through real-space engineering of quantum geometry10,11.
abstract_zh: 手性已成为在量子材料和分子化学中诱导自旋和Berry曲率现象的新机制1-7。顺磁体（AFMs）是自旋电子学和拓扑磁性的有前景材料，然而要实现大Berry曲率和自旋分裂带仍然具有挑战性8,9。在此，我们报告了一种从顺磁体出发的手性超晶格通往自旋分裂拓扑现象的路径。我们研究了顺磁体UOTe，在此我们展示了由冻结的手性光子在有限波向量处形成的自发手性超晶格。在超晶格之前，UOTe中未修饰的顺磁体既没有Berry曲率也没有自旋分裂带。当电子穿过手性超晶格时，其轨道布洛赫波函数和量子几何学会受到强手性超晶格势的调制，产生大Berry曲率，我们通过非线性霍尔效应检测到这一点。在150 K时，由手性超晶格诱导的Berry曲率与顺磁体有序耦合，在Néel温度TN附近突然出现约0.14的异常霍尔角，这在 bulk magnets（块体磁体）中属于最大值之一。此外，我们的自旋Hanle前蕴测量表明，手性超晶格也能从顺磁体产生自旋极化电流，这是自旋电子学的长期目标。我们基于化学离子尺寸和物理层间-层内能竞争的超调制形成机制阐明了相关物理图景，并利用该机制提出了一种发现类似键错配超晶格的设计原则，通过实空间工程学方法提供了一条手性超晶格途径，以调控量子几何10,11。
